source:

  def some_fun do
    if allowed? do
      :ok
    end
  end
end

origin: it should NOT report inline if without else
source:
defmodule CredoSampleModule do
  def some_fun do
    if allowed?, do: :ok
  end
end

origin: it should NOT report cond statement
source:

  def some_fun do
    cond do
      x < y -> -1
      x == y -> 0
      true -> 1
    end
  end
end

origin: it should NOT report multiple if statements without else
source:
defmodule CredoSampleModule do
  def some_fun do
    if condition1 do
      action1()
    end

    if condition2 do
      action2()
    end
  end
end

origin: it should NOT report module attribute named @if
it should report basic if/else block
source:
defmodule CredoSampleModule do
  def some_fun do
    if allowed? do
      :ok
    else
      :error
    end
  end
end

defmodule CredoSampleModule do
  def some_fun do
    if allowed?, do: :ok, else: :error

    cond do
      allowed? -> :ok
      true -> :error
    end
  end
end

source:

  def some_fun(x, y, z) do
    if x > y and y < z or z == 0 do
      :complex
    else
      :simple
    end
  end
end
